verdicts.why: Anatomical singleness, single-occupancy, isolation, and one-of-a-kind are factual sub-senses of 'single', not degrees of approval.
All name the same thing (causing negative feeling) and differ chiefly in how severe the verdict is, from displeasing up to infuriating.
The group splits by kind of skill (mental inventiveness vs manual dexterity vs muscular coordination); cunning and light-fingered are loaded outliers, not the axis.
Width, vantage point, brim shape, depth, and screen format are purely physical distinctions with no judgement in the choice.
Every member condemns harshness of tone and they differ only in how corrosive the writer wants to sound, from unpleasant to vitriolic.
Independence is carved by domain (national trade, personal autonomy, political secession, algebra, parasitism, record labels), a factual split.
The core 'old' words run a spectrum from reverent (antique, age-old, immemorial, hoary) to dismissive (antiquated, antediluvian, rusty), with a few neutral duration terms alongside.
All mean 'not used up' and differ only on neutral scope (financial resources, consumption) rather than any verdict.
All are approving; the differences are factual (infinite scope, divine source, age-derived, mere appearance) rather than a spectrum of warmth or harshness.
Every member criticises the same artificiality and a writer chooses among stilted, hokey, mannered, affected to set the flavour and sharpness of the criticism.
One physical state (thinness) judged from approving (lean) through neutral (thin) to alarming (emaciated, cadaverous, skeletal).
Deviation from the common is rendered neutrally (unusual, uncommon) or as praise (exceptional, special, rare, red-carpet), so the choice is a verdict.
Fog, mist, haze, cloud cover, and cloud-likeness are factual weather distinctions; dull and leaden add only a faint mood.
Beyond bare 'known', the group grades how warmly the subject is regarded, from noted through famous to illustrious and legendary.
Irrelevance is subdivided by kind (superficially relevant, not applicable, legally settled), a factual distinction rather than a change in harshness.
Solubility by solvent and dissolving vs melting are purely chemical facts.
Sea vs fresh water, partly vs fully submerged are habitat facts with no judgement attached.
Though all condemn, the members differ by the target of prejudice (race, sex, sexuality, gender identity) or by object (statements), which is a factual split.
The glosses describe the same doctrine of collective ownership with no evaluative gradient among the members.
Baseball pitch location, missing a target, and being erroneous are distinct factual senses, not degrees of censure.
Sediment, fog, frosting, powdery bloom, light-tightness, and milkiness are physical causes of opacity, not verdicts.
The same love of country is either praised (patriotic, loyal) or damned (jingoistic, chauvinistic, flag-waving), a pure verdict choice.
Deviation from the ordinary is rated from mildly intrigued (curious, odd) to mocking (grotesque, antic, crazy), so the writer picks a tone.
The same curiosity is approved (inquisitive, wondering) or condemned (nosy, prying, snoopy, overcurious).
The members split by what is unfavorable (circumstances, an expressed reproof, an unfair slight), which is a denotational rather than a force difference.
All are moral condemnations of conduct and differ in severity and colour, from shabby to ignominious and opprobrious.
Willing to agree, existing by consent, and complete agreement are factual shades of accord with no verdict involved.
Competing in general, striving in argument, eagerness to surpass, and having an adversary are denotational distinctions; combative is the lone loaded member.
The split is between merely genuine, verified as genuine, and informally emphatic genuine, which is evidential status and register rather than judgement.
Membership in the aristocracy, the peerage, or imperial rank is a factual class distinction; august, grand, and lordly are loaded outliers.
